thread:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: multiple Route53 healthchecks in eu-west-2 are flapping/failing (alert_id: 52371). Observability: 80% of probes reporting 5xx or timeout in last 3m. Paging eng-oncall.
Devon: seeing it too, dashboards show an uptick at 10:03 UTC. Not yet seeing customer error spikes in the frontend dashboards. :eyes:
Mia: I can confirm synthetic canaries are still healthy for the core API endpoints (eu-west-2 canary v2), so likely probe/monitoring issue vs full outage.
Akshay: any signs of regional failover events or BGP churn on cloud provider status page?
Devon: provider status is quiet, no posted incidents. Route53 healthcheck errors are coming from our probe aggregator though.
Lisa: NetEng, can you check the probe ingestion pipeline? last successful ingestion from eu-west-2 probes was 10:02 UTC then gaps.
NetEng: looking. We see a surge of 502s when probes talk to the probe-collector behind the ELB. Tail of collector logs shows an authorization error sporadically: "403 token expired" for an internal probe agent.
Mia: hmm, that would explain missing telemetry rather than real customer impact. But the pager fired because thresholds are based on probe counts.
Devon: threshold config: if >40% probes fail for 2m we page. Sounds like the token rotate job may have clobbered probe credentials.
Akshay: where is the token rotate job logs? I can grep deploy history.
Lisa: i-runbooks -> probe-auth has a quick rollback path. If it's credential rotation we can revert to previous token and restart collectors.
Devon: assigned action items: Akshay will triage token rotate, NetEng will open a temporary whitelist to stop healthcheck-based routing changes, Mia will watch customer-facing metrics.
Akshay: found a CI job that pushed a new token on 10:01 UTC and failed to update the collector secret due to a permissions regression. Reverting to previous secret now.
NetEng: adding a short-lived override to the healthcheck evaluator to ignore Route53 farm failures for 15m (manual suppression) to avoid auto reroute. Posting the command I'm running:

```
# disable auto-downgrade for eu-west-2 probes for 15m
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" https://ops.internal/api/health/evaluator/override \
  -d '{"region":"eu-west-2","suppress_for_mins":15,"reason":"probe-auth-rotation-fix"}'
```

NetEng: override applied. :white_check_mark:
Mia: frontend and API SLOs remain green, only latency noise on internal probe metrics. No customer error pages or increased 5xx from production hosts.
Devon: good. NetEng, once Akshay confirms collectors reconcile, remove the override and we'll let normal detection resume. Also create a postmortem ticket for the token rotation permission regression.
Akshay: collectors are restarting, auth checks now returning 200. I pushed the fixed secret to collector-kv and rolling restart started at 10:12 UTC.
PagerDuty-Bot: Escalation: scheduled follow-up at +30m.
Lisa: I'm opening INC-2143509876 in Jira to track RCA, mitigation timeline, and customer impact assessment. Assigning to Akshay + NetEng + SRE lead.
Devon: summary for comms: No customer-impacting errors observed. Root cause appears to be credential rotation failure causing probe telemetry loss and noisy Route53 healthchecks. Mitigations: reverted secret, restarted collectors, applied temporary suppress override.
Mia: will keep monitoring for 30m and update the incident ticket if anything changes.
NetEng: removing override in 14m to validate healthy signal flow prior to full restore.
Devon: thanks all. Quick follow-up: add a guard to the token rotation pipeline to fail if secret update to collector fails (don't rotate only on CI push). Logged an action item in INC-2143509876.
Mia: :thumbsup: logging metrics and will produce a short graph for postmortem showing probe success rate vs canary request success.
Devon: last check: collectors show 100% healthy now, probe success rates returned to baseline at 10:16 UTC. I'll close the page but keeping the incident ticket open for RCA.
Ops: closing page with note 'monitoring false positive due to probe auth rotation' at 10:26 UTC.
SRE-Bot: :white_check_mark: PAGE RESOLVED: 52371. Details: temporary suppression + secret revert. Follow-up ticket: INC-2143509876.
